text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary error rate spike: /v1/generate 5xxs at 9.2% over 2m on eu-west-1 (r-instruct-7B v2). Auto-rollback trigger fired.
amber_oncall: saw it, paging oncall. I'm on it.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback started -> rollout id=rl-2026-4822 step=canary revert to v1. Last action=drain-ingress on node-pool-7.
priya_sre: auto-rollback started but I see drain hang on 2 pods, `kubectl get pods -n inference` shows Terminating for >3m. Could be preStop blocking.
alex_eng: flipping feature flag `canary-split-v2` to 0% now to short-circuit traffic. @deploy-bot keep rollback paused until flag flip confirmed.
deply-bot: (deploy-bot) paused rollback per request.
jon_eng_oncall: I'll run manual traffic siphon to zero for the canary pool. Command: ```scripts/traffic_siphon.sh --pool canary-eu-west --to stable-eu-west --dry-run=false```
emily_cs: CS: 3 customers reported elevated latency on hosted-api, no P1s yet but one support ticket opened. I'm posting status to the SRE channel and coordinating comms.
sylvia_product_sre: quick check — are we expecting data loss? autoscaling might spin up new instances, just ensure no KV caches are invalidated.
priya_sre: confirming pods unblocked after sending SIGTERM+force after 30s. Doing `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0` on the two stuck ones.
amber_oncall: flag is at 0% (confirmed). Manual siphon running.
deploy-bot: rollback resumed -> draining complete for canary pool, shifting traffic to stable.
alex_eng: toggled canary metrics alert thresholds down while we stabilize.
priya_sre: running smoke tests against stable variant: `curl -s -X POST https://hosted/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` -> 200 OK, token latency 120ms.
emily_cs: updated customers affected list, one enterprise tenant had degraded qps for ~7 mins, support outreach in progress.
jon_eng_oncall: verification: error rate for /v1/generate now 0.4% on eu-west-1, 95p latency back to baseline. Rolling back health checks green.
sylvia_product_sre: recommend postmortem and flag gating for next rollout. Also schedule canary with smaller traffic for the reattempt.
amber_oncall: marking incident as mitigated in pager duty, handing off to morning SRE for RCA. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation=manual siphon + flag flip; rollback status=completed; customer impact=transient latency/5xxs for subset; severity=sev2.
alex_eng: leaving notes in the rollout ticket: adjust preStop hook, add shorter termination grace and force fallback.
priya_sre: will collect kube logs from the stuck pods and attach to the incident ticket.
emily_cs: CS will follow up with affected customers with timeline.
amber_oncall: closing oncall handoff, leaving it for the next rotation to complete RCA. If anything regresses ping me.
jon_eng_oncall: post-check list executed: smoke, load test ramp to 2x baseline, no regressions.
sylvia_product_sre: adding action item: block new canary pushes until preStop fix verified.
incident-bot: Incident resolved at 4822109908.
